scripts.deep-clean: yarn run clean && del-cli -f node_modules && del-cli -f yarn.lock
scripts.build-init: yarn run dev-init && yarn run clean && yarn install && yarn upgrade --pattern strata
scripts.build: yarn run build-init && tsc && cd main/typescript && yarn run increment-snapshot && cd ../.. && yarn run copy-package && cd build/dist && yarn pack
scripts.publish-package: yarn run build && cd build/dist && yarn publish --non-interactive --tag 0.0.0-snapshot
